in_marathi.name: Agneesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agneesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Agneesh is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Agni', which means fire. In Hindu mythology, Agneesh is considered to be the god of fire and the protector of the home. This name is believed to bestow upon the bearer the qualities of bravery, strength, and power.
